theme_strategy: Light mode primary (standard for clinical environments to maximize legibility and minimize reflections), with a high-contrast dark mode toggle.

typography.notes: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato. Use 'Work Sans' for clear, authoritative headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for highly legible, dense tabular data in the body.

forbidden_colors: #1B93A4 (Teal Green/Blue is completely banned for this dashboard)
colors.notes: Use 'Tinted Grey' - never pure #000000 or #808080. Tint neutrals with cool blue (slate). Avoid large gradients; rely on solid, high-contrast colors for clarity. Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat Solid surfaces. 1px crisp border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800). Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md). NO heavy drop shadows, use shadow-sm sparingly.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. NEVER use transparent backgrounds without a blur/scrim.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: FORBIDDEN for clinical apps. Flat solid surfaces prevent visual refraction of critical medical data.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.banners: Use high-contrast solid colors for the 'NOT YET CLINICALLY VALIDATED' banner. Should be unmistakable (e.g., Amber background with dark brown text, bold).

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between cards to maintain data density.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layouts_and_grids.pathway_selector: Grid of 6 distinct clinical scenarios. grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align dense clinical content, paragraphs, and inputs. Optical alignment over geometrical.

components_strategy.general: Heavily customize Shadcn UI components. Strip the default 'Vercel-look'. Go cardless where possible or use rectangular, dense styles.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. Dense layouts for clinical scenario forms (e.g., 3-gen pedigree-lite, NIPT lab fields).
components_strategy.date_picker: Shadcn Calendar (Do not use raw HTML input type='date').
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn chart components (recharts) for the Basic metrics dashboard.
components_strategy.tabs: Override Shadcn tabs default h-9 with h-auto to prevent content cutoff.

motion_and_interactions.guidelines: Minimalist. Use micro-interactions for hover/focus feedback. Do not use distracting heavy animations.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease). NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

accessibility.contrast: APCA guidelines preferred. Normal text min 4.5:1. Interactive elements min 3:1 against adjacent colors.
accessibility.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='referral-submit-button').
accessibility.state_visibility: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. E.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' (default) or '@phosphor-icons/react' (dense dashboards). Keep icons purposeful, not merely decorative.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Clear, informative, no playful illustrations. Use clinical, straightforward messaging.
visual_enhancers.citations: Ensure guideline sources (ACOG, NCCN, ACMG) are styled distinctly (e.g., muted text, small badge) to look like trustworthy references.

media_and_images.notes: Medical app needs minimalistic imagery. Avatars for providers or patients.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a clinical decision support tool, not a consumer app. It must look highly trustworthy, fast, and legible.
Result screen must be legible in under 5 seconds. Use massive, undeniable typography for the final decision (No Referral, Routine, Urgent) and color-code appropriately.
Frame everything as decision support, never a definitive diagnosis. Prominently display 'NOT YET CLINICALLY VALIDATED' on placeholder criteria.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Rely entirely on Shadcn.
Include 'data-testid' on every button, link, form input, and status result.
Use solid background colors for cards and headers. Glassmorphism is banned to ensure peak readability of medical data.
Ensure guideline citations (ACOG, NCCN, ACMG) are attached to every decision rule displayed.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make it clinical but uniquely sharp and well-structured.
Do NOT center align the main app container (no .App { text-align: center; }). Keep text naturally flowing left-aligned for readability.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing inside containers than default to avoid cramped, cheap looks, but use tight gaps between widgets for density.
Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions.
Ensure 'sonner' is used for all toasts.
